purpose: Inventory-only test of whether episode-order proximity to a canonical strict episode on the same Group A date narrows the non-strict universe while retaining known blind strict misses. No source review or reclassification was performed.

methodology.scope: Exactly the 150 Group A dates and 576 canonical non-strict episodes already materialized in the source adjacency inventory.
methodology.ordering: Within each Group A date, all canonical alert episodes are sorted by alert_start; existing positions in the source ordered timeline are preserved.
methodology.episode_order_distance: For each canonical non-strict episode, take the minimum absolute difference between its ordered position and the ordered position of any canonical strict episode on the same date. Clock-time gaps do not affect this distance.
methodology.multiple_strict_rule: Minimum episode-order distance to any strict episode on the same date. All strict episode IDs tied at the minimum order distance are preserved. A deterministic primary nearest strict is selected for single-ID reporting: prefer a tied strict that is also the source artifact's minimum-time-gap strict; otherwise choose the earlier strict position.
methodology.relative_position: before when the non-strict episode position is lower than the selected nearest strict position; after when higher.
methodology.time_gap: Copied from the existing adjacency artifact where available; no new temporal thresholding is used for order-distance classification.
methodology.previous_qa_status: Inherited unchanged from the source adjacency artifact. Priority there is known_confirmed_miss, known_needs_review, blind_audited_negative, gap_audited_negative, not_previously_audited.

O1.definition: All Group A canonical non-strict episodes.

O2.definition: Group A non-strict episodes with episode-order distance <=1 to a canonical strict episode on the same date.

O3.definition: Group A non-strict episodes with episode-order distance <=2 to a canonical strict episode on the same date.

O4.definition: Group A non-strict episodes with episode-order distance <=3 to a canonical strict episode on the same date.

O5.definition: Group A non-strict episodes with episode-order distance <=4 to a canonical strict episode on the same date.

descriptive_comparison.note: Episode-order <=2 is wider than direct adjacency but preserves both blind misses; <=3 is wider still and covers all five known Group A confirmed misses. These are coverage/descriptive facts only, not estimates of miss rate.

limitations: This is an inventory over existing canonical/QA labels, not a new evidence review.
Episode-order distance ignores elapsed clock time by design; adjacent positions can be hours apart.
The five known confirmed misses are discoveries from prior non-random QA processes and are not a basis for estimating prevalence or miss rate.
Blind-wave positives are useful coverage checks but two positives are too few to estimate the performance of a filter.
QA status is inherited from the source adjacency artifact; no underlying source evidence was reopened.
No claim is made that episodes outside any selected order-distance universe are negative.
